name: Absorption native Great Work API availability on the saved PR87 game

steps.code:
local function method(object,name)
 local ok,value=pcall(function() return object and object[name] end)
 return ok and type(value)=='function'
end
local function dispatchMethods()
 return {RequestPlayerOperation=method(UI,'RequestPlayerOperation'),GetWorkingDeal=method(DealManager,'GetWorkingDeal'),GetPossibleDealItems=method(DealManager,'GetPossibleDealItems'),EnactWorkingDeal=method(DealManager,'EnactWorkingDeal'),SendWorkingDeal=method(DealManager,'SendWorkingDeal')}
end
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local selected,first=nil,nil
for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do
 local ok,slots=pcall(A.OwnedGreatWorkSlots,owner)
 if ok and #slots>0 then selected=owner;first=slots[1];break end
end
selected=selected or Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local ok,core=pcall(A.NativeWorkCapabilities,selected)
local result={SelectedOwner=selected,FirstWork=first,GameplayOK=ok,Gameplay=ok and core or nil,GameplayError=not ok and tostring(core) or nil}
result.Context='Gameplay';result.Dispatch=dispatchMethods();Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_WORK_CONTEXT_PROBE',{SelectedOwner=selected,FirstWork=first,GameplayDispatch=result.Dispatch});print('[JAC_NATIVE_WORK_CORE_API] '..A.Canonical(result))
return A.Canonical(result)

local function method(object,name)
 local ok,value=pcall(function() return object and object[name] end)
 return ok and type(value)=='function'
end
local function dispatchMethods()
 return {RequestPlayerOperation=method(UI,'RequestPlayerOperation'),GetWorkingDeal=method(DealManager,'GetWorkingDeal'),GetPossibleDealItems=method(DealManager,'GetPossibleDealItems'),EnactWorkingDeal=method(DealManager,'EnactWorkingDeal'),SendWorkingDeal=method(DealManager,'SendWorkingDeal')}
end

local A=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption)
local snapshot=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_WORK_CONTEXT_PROBE'),'paired Gameplay sample missing')
local owner=snapshot.SelectedOwner
local player=assert(Players[owner])
local result={Context='InGame',SelectedOwner=owner,LocalPlayer=Game.GetLocalPlayer(),FirstWork=snapshot.FirstWork,Methods={},Operations={},GameplayDispatch=snapshot.GameplayDispatch,UIDispatch=dispatchMethods()}
local objects={UI=UI,Game=Game,DealManager=DealManager}
local names={'RequestPlayerOperation','GetWorkingDeal','GetPossibleDealItems','EnactWorkingDeal','SendWorkingDeal'}
for _,label in ipairs({'UI','Game','DealManager'}) do
 result.Methods[label]={}
 for _,name in ipairs(names) do result.Methods[label][name]=method(objects[label],name) end
end
for _,name in ipairs({'MOVE_GREAT_WORK','PARAM_PLAYER_ONE','PARAM_CITY_SRC','PARAM_CITY_DEST','PARAM_BUILDING_SRC','PARAM_BUILDING_DEST','PARAM_GREAT_WORK_INDEX','PARAM_SLOT'}) do
 result.Operations[name]=PlayerOperations and PlayerOperations[name]~=nil or false
end
if snapshot.FirstWork then
 local w=snapshot.FirstWork
 local physical=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(w.X,w.Y),'paired source city missing')
 assert(physical:GetOwner()==owner and physical:GetID()==w.CityID,'paired source owner/ID changed')
 result.PhysicalIndex=physical:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(w.Building,w.Slot)
 assert(result.PhysicalIndex==w.Index,'Gameplay/UI samples refer to different physical work')
end
print('[JAC_NATIVE_WORK_UI_API] '..A.Canonical(result))
return A.Canonical(result)
